title: Add ShoppingListFiles Regression Tests
description: Add or extend CookbookAppTests coverage for ShoppingListFiles read/write helper signature behavior and bracketing-balance invariant using temporary file fixtures.
acceptance_criteria: Tests write and read shopping-list markdown through the new folderURL-aware helper signatures.
Tests verify callers do not need to pre-bracket the folder URL for simulator happy-path IO.
Tests include a focused invariant for balanced access start/stop behavior where feasible in the existing test architecture.
Tests do not claim to reproduce the on-device entitlement-loss failure mode.

handoff_summary.completed: All 4 acceptance criteria satisfied: (1) write+read roundtrip through folderURL-aware signatures — covered by writeTextAndReadTextRoundtrip, writeTextCreatesFileAtExpectedURL, discoverFindsFileWrittenViaWriteText; (2) callers need no pre-bracketing — covered by callerDoesNotNeedToPreBracketFolderURL; (3) balanced start/stop invariant — covered by bracketingBalanceOnSimulatorURL with explicit didStart==false assertion; (4) on-device entitlement-loss mode not claimed — documented in the bracketingBalance test comment.
handoff_summary.remaining: None for this bead. ShoppingListViewTests.swift has pre-existing build errors (missing folderURL: in two ShoppingListDetailView init calls) introduced by bead B-c0e266d9; those require a fix in that file.
handoff_summary.risks: Pre-existing build failure in ShoppingListViewTests.swift blocks the full test suite. The tester agent will hit this when running tests. A sub-bead or fix for ShoppingListViewTests.swift is needed before the suite is green.
handoff_summary.next_action: Fix ShoppingListViewTests.swift — add missing folderURL: argument to the two ShoppingListDetailView init calls (lines 16 and 21) — then hand to the tester agent.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: ShoppingListViewTests.swift (lines 16, 21) fails to compile due to missing folderURL: parameter introduced by bead B-c0e266d9. This blocks the tester agent from running any tests in the CookbookAppTests target.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Balanced-bracketing invariant tests the simulator's didStart=false precondition directly rather than mocking URL internals — this is the only feasible approach within the existing test architecture since startAccessingSecurityScopedResource is a value-type method that cannot be swapped out.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: 6 new tests added. Covers: write+read roundtrip, file creation side-effect, nil-on-missing-file, no-pre-bracket caller contract, nested-bracketing via discover, and simulator balanced-bracketing precondition. On-device entitlement-loss path explicitly excluded per acceptance criterion 4.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: bracketingBalanceOnSimulatorURL only verifies the didStart=false simulator path. The didStart=true path (real security-scoped bookmarks on device) is architecturally untestable in unit tests without entitlements.

conflict_risks: ShoppingListViewTests.swift (lines 16, 21) fails to compile due to missing folderURL: parameter introduced by bead B-c0e266d9. This blocks the tester agent from running any tests in the CookbookAppTests target.

execution_history.summary: Added 6 regression tests to CookbookAppTests/ShoppingListFilesTests.swift covering the folderURL-aware readText/writeText signatures, no-pre-bracket invariant, nested-bracket safety via discover, and balanced-bracketing simulator precondition. A pre-existing build failure in ShoppingListViewTests.swift (missing folderURL: in ShoppingListDetailView call sites, from bead B-c0e266d9) is unrelated to this bead.
